items.title: Patient experiences with a prescription-based digital health application (DiGA) for knee disorders: a qualitative study in german orthopaedic care.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 10 German patients with knee disorders found high acceptance of a prescription-based digital health application (DiGA) for prehabilitation and continuity of care, valuing its flexibility and structured guidance, though challenges included personalization and integration without professional support.
items.curatedReason: 这项德国定性研究表明，膝关节疾患患者普遍接受数字健康应用（DiGA）作为物理治疗的补充，尤其在术前康复和持续护理中。它提醒你，在将这类工具整合到诊所实践时，应关注患者对个性化、可用性和专业指导支持的需求。
items.titleZh: 膝关节疾病患者对处方数字健康应用（DiGA）的体验：德国骨科护理中的一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 10 名德国膝关节疾病患者的定性研究发现，患者普遍接受处方数字健康应用（DiGA）用于术前康复和持续护理，并重视其灵活性和结构化指导，但挑战包括个性化不足和缺乏专业支持下的整合问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This German qualitative study indicates that patients with knee disorders generally accept digital health applications (DiGAs) as a complement to physical therapy, particularly for prehabilitation and continuity of care. It advises you to consider patient needs regarding personalization, usability, and professional guidance when integrating such tools into clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（10 名患者），且仅限于德国的特定人群和系统，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a small sample size (10 patients) and was limited to a specific population and healthcare system in Germany, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Changes in cervical muscle mechanical properties during orofacial motor tasks in individuals with and without chronic neck pain
items.summary: In 84 adults, orofacial motor tasks significantly altered cervical muscle mechanical properties (e.g., frequency, stiffness, relaxation time, creep) in sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles, regardless of chronic neck pain status. While the neck pain group showed lower absolute tongue pressure, task-related cervical responses did not consistently differ between groups.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，口面部运动会改变颈部肌肉的力学特性，在有或没有慢性颈痛的人群中都如此。尽管慢性颈痛组的舌压较低，但口面部任务对颈部肌肉的整体影响似乎相似。这加强了我们对颈部和口面部系统相互作用的理解，提醒你在评估颈痛患者时，别忘了检查口面部功能，它可能是一部分问题的来源。
items.titleZh: 慢性颈痛患者与健康个体在口面部运动任务中颈部肌肉力学特性的变化
items.summaryZh: 在 84 名成人中，口面部运动任务显著改变了胸锁乳突肌和斜方肌的颈部肌肉力学特性（如频率、僵硬度、松弛时间、蠕变），无论其是否有慢性颈痛。尽管颈痛组的舌压绝对值较低，但与任务相关的颈部反应在两组间并未持续表现出差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Orofacial motor tasks appear to alter cervical muscle mechanics, regardless of chronic neck pain status, though the chronic neck pain group did exhibit lower absolute tongue pressure. This bolsters the idea of functional interplay between the cervical and orofacial systems. When assessing neck pain, remember to screen for orofacial contributions; they could be part of the picture.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果外推性受限于所测量的特定肌肉和任务。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional observational study cannot establish causality, and generalizability is limited by the specific muscles and tasks measured.

items.title: Wearable Sensors Predict Exertion Without Changes in Pulse Rate for Frail End-Stage Kidney Disease Patients
items.summary: A study of 13 ESKD patients and 13 healthy controls found that multi-modal wearable sensors significantly improved the prediction of perceived exertion (RMSE 1.33) in ESKD patients, whose pulse rate alone was insufficient due to beta-blocker use and lower physical capacity, highlighting the need for distinct algorithms for this population.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了在衰弱的终末期肾病（ESKD）患者中，传统的脉率监测不足以预测运动劳累程度，而多模态可穿戴传感器能显著提高劳累预测的准确性。这提示你在为 ESKD 患者进行术前康复时，需要采用更先进、多维度的监测技术，而非依赖单一脉率指标。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴传感器在衰弱终末期肾病患者中无需脉率变化即可预测劳累
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 13 名终末期肾病（ESKD）患者和 13 名健康对照的研究发现，多模态可穿戴传感器显著提高了 ESKD 患者劳累程度的预测准确性（RMSE 1.33）。由于 ESKD 患者使用β受体阻滞剂且体能较低，仅依赖脉率不足以预测劳累，这凸显了为该人群开发独特算法的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that traditional pulse rate monitoring is insufficient to predict exertion in frail end-stage kidney disease (ESKD) patients, and multi-modal wearable sensors significantly improve exertion prediction accuracy. This suggests that when conducting prehabilitation for ESKD patients, you need to adopt more advanced, multi-dimensional monitoring technologies rather than relying solely on pulse rate.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（ESKD 组和对照组各 13 人），且为一项概念验证研究，结果的普适性需更大规模临床试验验证。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (13 participants per group for ESKD and controls) and is a proof-of-concept study, requiring larger clinical trials to validate generalizability.

items.title: Effectiveness of wearable and non-wearable biofeedback on knee biomechanics during functional tasks in anterior cruciate ligament injury prevention and rehabilitation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 24 studies found that biofeedback significantly reduced peak knee abduction angle (Hedges’ g = 0.52, 95% CI 0.06 to 0.98, p = 0.03) in ACL injury prevention, but no significant effects for other knee biomechanics, with low to very low certainty of evidence.
items.curatedReason: 生物反馈在 ACL 损伤预防中，对减少膝外翻角度有显著但低确定性的效应。临床上应谨慎解读这些结果，并告知患者，在更确凿的证据出现前，生物反馈仍是辅助手段，不能替代核心力量和神经肌肉控制训练。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴和非穿戴式生物反馈对 ACL 损伤预防和康复中膝关节生物力学的影响：系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含24项研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，生物反馈在ACL损伤预防中显著降低了膝关节外展峰值角度（Hedges’ g = 0.52），但对其他膝关节生物力学参数无显著影响，证据确定性为低至极低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Biofeedback significantly but with low certainty reduces peak knee abduction angle in ACL injury prevention. Clinicians should interpret these results cautiously and inform patients that biofeedback remains an adjunctive tool, not a substitute for core strength and neuromuscular control training, until more definitive evidence emerges.
items.limitation: 证据确定性为低至极低，且多数研究质量受偏倚风险、不精确性和不一致性影响。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence ranged from low to very low, with most studies affected by risk of bias, imprecision, and inconsistency.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of a multidisciplinary programme compared to usual care for people with low back pain in Belgium
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study in Belgium found that a multidisciplinary LBP program (FEDRIS pathway) was associated with higher costs (€7374) and longer disability (~111 days) compared to standard multidisciplinary rehabilitation (MBR) (€4792; ~65 days) and usual care (€4803; ~80 days), with standard MBR showing superior cost-effectiveness.
items.curatedReason: 这项比利时研究提示，多学科康复项目并非总是成本效益最优解。在评估 LBP 患者的转归时，考虑标准 MBR 的潜在优势，尤其在比利时等有类似报销机制的地区。
items.titleZh: 比利时多学科项目与常规护理对腰痛患者的疗效和成本效益比较
items.summaryZh: 一项比利时回顾性队列研究发现，针对腰痛患者，FEDRIS 多学科康复路径的成本（€7374）和致残持续时间（约111天）均高于标准多学科康复（€4792；约65天）和常规护理（€4803；约80天），而标准多学科康复显示出更优的成本效益。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Belgian study suggests that multidisciplinary rehabilitation programs are not always the most cost-effective solution. Consider the potential advantages of standard MBR when evaluating outcomes for LBP patients, especially in regions with similar reimbursement mechanisms.
items.limitation: 回顾性队列研究设计可能存在未调整的混杂因素，且数据来源于比利时特定行政数据库，外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective cohort study design may have unadjusted confounders, and data from specific Belgian administrative databases limit generalizability.

items.title: Artificial intelligence-assisted assessment of the forward roll in the Fundamental Motor Skills in Sport (FUS) test: agreement with expert consensus, inter-rater reliability, and rater workload
items.summary: An AI system showed substantial to almost perfect agreement with expert consensus (kappa 0.73–0.85; quadratic weighted kappa 0.95) for assessing forward rolls in children's motor skills. Human ratings with AI support more closely matched expert consensus (mean absolute error 0.68 vs 0.99) and raters reported less effort.
items.curatedReason: AI 辅助评估在儿童基础运动技能测试中展现出与专家高度一致的潜力。在儿科康复领域，这预示着未来 AI 有望成为评估工具，减轻评估者负担，提升评估标准化与可靠性。
items.titleZh: 人工智能辅助评估儿童运动技能测试中的前滚翻：与专家共识的一致性、评分者间可靠性和评分者工作量
items.summaryZh: 一项研究显示，在评估儿童前滚翻运动技能时，AI 系统与专家共识具有高度一致性（kappa 0.73–0.85；加权kappa 0.95）。AI 辅助下的人工评分与专家共识更接近（平均绝对误差 0.68 vs 0.99），且评分者报告工作量减少。
items.curatedReasonEn: AI-assisted assessment shows high potential for agreement with expert consensus in children's fundamental motor skills tests. In pediatric rehabilitation, this suggests AI could become a valuable assessment tool, reducing assessor workload and improving standardization and reliability.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅为硕士生评估者，且评估条件标准化，结论外推至实践教师或其他年龄组需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study involved only master's students as raters under standardized video conditions, limiting generalizability to practicing teachers or other age groups.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Physical Therapy in the News: October 2026
items.summary: APTA's monthly series, "Physical Therapy in the News: October 2026," highlights recent media coverage of the physical therapy profession and APTA members in the United States.
items.curatedReason: 这份每月新闻汇总能让你快速了解美国物理治疗行业近期在公共媒体上的形象和关注焦点。虽然具体细节还未公布，但你可以借此洞察行业宣传的侧重和公众讨论的趋势。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗新闻：2026 年 10 月 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 的月度系列报道“物理治疗新闻：2026 年 10 月”汇总了美国物理治疗专业和 APTA 成员近期在媒体上的报道。
items.curatedReasonEn: This monthly news roundup offers a quick pulse check on how the physical therapy profession is being portrayed in public media in the U.S. While specific content isn't yet available, you can use this to gauge PR trends and public perception of PT.

items.title: Benefits and limitations of robotic gait exoskeletons in functional rehabilitation of children with cerebral palsy: an umbrella review.
items.summary: An umbrella review found Robot-Assisted Gait Training (RAGT) improves overall motor function, specifically GMFM-88 dimensions D and E, in children with cerebral palsy. However, improvements in spatiotemporal gait parameters were inconsistent, and RAGT did not consistently outperform treadmill training or conventional physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 针对脑瘫儿童，机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）在整体运动功能上优于传统康复或跑步机训练，特别是在粗大运动功能量表GMFM-88的D和E维度。但在步态时空参数的改善上效果不一致，提示它作为辅助手段更有价值。
items.titleZh: 脑瘫儿童功能康复中机器人步态外骨骼的益处与局限性：一项伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项伞形综述显示，机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）能改善脑瘫儿童的整体运动功能，尤其在GMFM-88的D和E维度上。然而，其对步态时空参数的改善效果不一致，且未显示出相比跑步机训练或传统物理治疗的持续优势。
items.curatedReasonEn: For children with cerebral palsy, Robot-Assisted Gait Training (RAGT) shows superiority in overall motor function over conventional or treadmill training, particularly in GMFM-88 dimensions D and E. However, its effects on spatiotemporal gait parameters are inconsistent, suggesting its value as a complementary intervention.
items.limitation: 该综述未报告除GMFM-88外的其他临床、运动学、动力学或肌电图测量，可能限制了对RAGT全面效果的评估。
items.limitationEn: The review did not report clinical, kinematic, kinetic, or EMG measures other than GMFM-88, which may limit the comprehensive evaluation of RAGT's effects.

items.title: Interval Between Injury and Surgery Influences Knee Biomechanics During Walking in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstructed Patients: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 studies found that delayed ACL reconstruction (≥12 months) is associated with persistent sagittal plane deficits in walking biomechanics, while early surgery (<6 months) correlates with fewer long-term sagittal-plane deficits but may have temporary frontal-plane asymmetries.
items.curatedReason: 很明确，ACL 重建最好别拖。如果患者术前等待时间超过 12 个月，你就要做好长期矢状面步态缺陷的康复准备。反之，若能在 6 个月内手术，长期矢状面缺陷会少很多，但要留意术后可能出现的暂时性冠状面不对称。
items.titleZh: 损伤与手术间隔时间影响前交叉韧带重建患者行走时的膝关节生物力学：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对16项研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，延迟前交叉韧带重建（≥12个月）与行走生物力学中的矢状面缺陷持续存在相关，而早期手术（<6个月）则与较少的长期矢状面缺陷相关，但可能存在暂时的额状面不对称。
items.curatedReasonEn: Don't delay ACL reconstruction. If your patient waits ≥12 months pre-surgery, prepare for persistent sagittal plane gait deficits in their long-term rehab. Conversely, early surgery (<6 months) significantly reduces long-term sagittal plane deficits, though you might see temporary frontal plane asymmetries post-op.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的异质性较高，尤其在膝关节屈曲力矩（I² = 76%）和长期膝关节屈曲力矩（I² = 88%）的分析中，可能影响结果的稳定性。
items.limitationEn: The study exhibits high heterogeneity, particularly in analyses of peak knee flexion moment (I² = 76%) and long-term peak knee flexion moment (I² = 88%), which may affect result stability.

items.title: Comparative Effects of Neurostimulation- and Technology-Augmented Robot-Assisted Training on Upper-Limb Motor Recovery After Stroke: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 103 trials (5,251 participants) found rTMS plus robot-assisted training yielded the largest Fugl-Meyer Assessment for Upper Extremity estimate (MD = 9.56) for poststroke upper-limb recovery, followed by low-frequency electrical stimulation plus RAT (MD = 7.52), compared to usual care.
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析提示，rTMS 联合机器人辅助训练可能在卒中后上肢运动恢复方面效果最好（9.56 分），其次是低频电刺激加机器人辅助训练（7.52 分）。在设计康复方案时，你可考虑这些组合干预的潜在增效作用。
items.titleZh: 神经刺激与技术增强型机器人辅助训练对卒中后上肢运动恢复的比较效应：一项系统综述与网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含103项试验（5251名参与者）的网络荟萃分析发现，与常规护理相比，rTMS 联合机器人辅助训练对卒中后上肢运动恢复的 Fugl-Meyer 上肢评估量表估值最大（平均差 = 9.56），其次是低频电刺激联合机器人辅助训练（平均差 = 7.52）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis suggests that rTMS combined with robot-assisted training may be most effective for post-stroke upper-limb motor recovery (9.56 points), followed by low-frequency electrical stimulation plus robot-assisted training (7.52 points). You may consider the potential synergistic effects of these combined interventions when designing rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 证据确定性为极低到中等，且缺乏头对头比较证据，限制了确切的干预优先级。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence ranges from very low to moderate, and there is a lack of head-to-head comparative evidence, limiting a definitive hierarchy of interventions.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of chair-based exercise training on pulmonary function, exercise capacity, and quality of life in patients with acute exacerbation of COPD: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 30 AECOPD patients found that chair-based exercise training significantly improved functional exercise capacity (79.7m vs 28.8m in 6MWT), dyspnoea, and quality of life compared to breathing exercises alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证据表明，在急性 COPD 加重住院期间，基于椅子的运动训练安全可行，并能显著改善患者的功能运动能力、呼吸困难和生活质量。你可以考虑将这种形式的早期活动整合到 COPD 患者的住院康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 基于椅子的运动训练对急性加重期 COPD 患者肺功能、运动能力和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对30名急性加重期慢阻肺患者的随机对照试验发现，与单纯呼吸练习相比，基于椅子的运动训练显著改善了功能运动能力（6分钟步行试验中为79.7米 vs 28.8米）、呼吸困难和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT evidence indicates that chair-based exercise training is safe and feasible during hospitalization for acute COPD exacerbations, significantly improving functional exercise capacity, dyspnea, and quality of life. You can consider integrating this form of early mobilization into rehabilitation protocols for hospitalized COPD patients.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（30名患者），且为单中心研究，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (30 patients) and is single-center, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Inertial measurement unit-based gait analysis for objective assessment of vestibular rehabilitation.
items.summary: IMU-based gait analysis, even with a single pelvis sensor, captured significant improvements in walking speed, Gait Profile Score, and cadence in 30 acute vestibular syndrome patients after 6 weeks of vestibular rehabilitation, maintained at 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，即使使用单个惯性测量单元（IMU）传感器也能捕捉到急性前庭综合征患者步态的改善，这为在临床实践中更广泛地采用可穿戴设备进行客观评估提供了可行性证据。
items.titleZh: 基于惯性测量单元的步态分析对前庭康复进行客观评估
items.summaryZh: 即使只使用单个骨盆传感器，基于惯性测量单元的步态分析也能捕捉到30名急性前庭综合征患者在6周前庭康复后步行速度、步态剖面评分和步频的显著改善，并在12周随访中保持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates that even a single inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor can capture gait improvements in patients with acute vestibular syndrome, providing feasibility evidence for wider adoption of wearable devices for objective assessment in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究的样本量相对较小（30名AVS患者），且对照组只进行了一次评估，可能无法完全反映对照组的变异性。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small (30 AVS patients), and the control group was assessed only once, which may not fully reflect control group variability.

items.title: Physiotherapy and Exercise-Based Rehabilitation for Mental Health: A Two-Decade Bibliometric Analysis of Global Trends, Thematic Evolution, and the Socioeconomic Vulnerability Gap (2006-2025).
items.summary: A bibliometric analysis of 5223 publications (2006-2025) on physical rehabilitation and mental health found a 22.6-fold increase in annual publications, with 75.9% originating from high-income countries and socioeconomic vulnerability identified as an under-researched thematic cluster.
items.curatedReason: 这份文献计量分析显示，物理康复与心理健康交叉领域的研究显著增长，但高收入国家贡献了绝大部分。这提醒你，在低资源环境下，针对社会经济脆弱人群的成本效益和实施科学研究是未来的重要方向。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗和运动康复对心理健康的影响：一项关于全球趋势、主题演变和社会经济脆弱性差距（2006-2025）的二十年文献计量分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对2006-2025年间物理康复与心理健康领域5223篇出版物的文献计量分析发现，年发文量增长了22.6倍，其中75.9%来自高收入国家，社会经济脆弱性被识别为一个研究不足的主题群。
items.curatedReasonEn: This bibliometric analysis reveals substantial growth in research at the intersection of physical rehabilitation and mental health, with high-income countries contributing the majority. This indicates that in low-resource settings, cost-effectiveness and implementation science research for socioeconomically vulnerable populations are critical future directions.
items.limitation: 社会经济脆弱性关键词的识别存在较高的假阳性率（62.5%），可能导致对该主题覆盖范围的误判。
items.limitationEn: The keyword identification for socioeconomic vulnerability had a high false-positive rate (62.5%), potentially leading to misestimation of topic coverage.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Early Prediction of Discharge Outcomes in Geriatric Rehabilitation: Development and Temporal Validation of a Multiclass Model
items.summary: A multiclass prediction model developed using multinomial regression and XGBoost accurately predicted discharge outcomes (minimal dependency, nursing-care dependency, or medical deterioration) in 10,920 geriatric rehabilitation patients by day 7, achieving an AUC of 0.81.
items.curatedReason: 这个多分类模型能在亚急性康复第7天有效预测老年患者的三个出院结局，其 AUC 达到 0.81。这提示你可以在早期利用这类工具识别高危患者，更早启动社工介入或加强对恶化风险的监测。
items.titleZh: 老年康复出院结局的早期预测：多分类模型的开发与时间验证
items.summaryZh: 一项使用多项式回归和 XGBoost 开发的多分类预测模型，在10920名老年康复患者中，能在第7天准确预测出院结局（最低依赖、护理依赖或医疗恶化），AUC 达到0.81。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multiclass model effectively predicts three discharge outcomes for geriatric patients on day 7 of subacute rehabilitation, with an AUC of 0.81. This suggests you can use such tools early to identify high-risk patients, initiating social work involvement sooner or increasing monitoring for deterioration risk.
items.limitation: 模型是在一家公立老年康复医院的单一健康维护组织成员数据上开发的，结果在不同机构或人群中的通用性尚需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The model was developed using data from members of a single HMO at a public geriatric rehabilitation hospital; its generalizability to other institutions or populations requires further validation.

items.title: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 12 physiotherapists in South Africa identified limited undergraduate training, inadequate resources, understaffing, and poor referral pathways as barriers to managing pelvic floor disorders in public hospitals.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示南非公立医院物理治疗师在盆底功能障碍管理上面临的挑战，包括培训不足、资源匮乏和转诊系统不完善，这在一定程度上反映了全球基层医疗的共性问题。
items.titleZh: 南非 uThukela 地区公立医院物理治疗师在盆底功能障碍管理中的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对南非12名物理治疗师的定性研究发现，本科培训不足、资源匮乏、人员配备不足以及转诊路径不畅是公立医院盆底功能障碍管理的主要障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights challenges faced by physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders in South African public hospitals, including inadequate training, resource scarcity, and poor referral systems, reflecting common issues in global primary healthcare.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: Health-seeking behaviours of people with osteoarthritis in sub-Saharan Africa: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of five studies found that health-seeking behaviors for osteoarthritis in sub-Saharan Africa are often delayed or fragmented, influenced by beliefs, poor knowledge, limited person-centered care, and access barriers.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述指出了撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者就医行为的延迟和碎片化。这提示你，在资源受限地区，加强患者教育、推广自我管理和拓展社区康复服务尤为重要。
items.titleZh: 撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为：范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对五项研究的范围综述发现，撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为常延迟或碎片化，受信念、知识不足、以患者为中心的护理有限以及服务障碍等因素影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review highlights delayed and fragmented health-seeking behaviors among osteoarthritis patients in sub-Saharan Africa. This suggests that in resource-limited settings, strengthening patient education, promoting self-management, and expanding community-based rehabilitation are particularly crucial.
items.limitation: 纳入的文献数量非常有限，且主要集中在尼日利亚和南非的农村地区，限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The review included a very limited number of studies, primarily from rural Nigeria and South Africa, which restricts the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: A COSMIN systematic review of performance-based assessment tools for mealtime performance in Parkinson's disease: a linking study based on the ICF framework.
items.summary: A COSMIN systematic review identified only two performance-based outcome measurement instruments (PerFOMs) for mealtime performance in Parkinson's disease, the Mealtime Assessment Scale and a modified OARS scale, neither of which has been fully validated for content.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提醒你，帕金森病患者的进餐困难不只局限于吞咽，还涉及姿势、餐具使用和认知注意力。仅有的两种基于表现的评估工具均未完全验证，你需要更全面地评估患者的进餐能力，而不仅仅是吞咽功能。
items.titleZh: COSMIN 系统综述评估帕金森病患者进餐表现的基于表现的评估工具：一项基于 ICF 框架的关联研究
items.summaryZh: 一项 COSMIN 系统综述确定了帕金森病患者进餐表现的两种基于表现的评估工具：进餐评估量表和改良版老年美国人资源和服务量表，但两者均未进行全面的内容验证。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review reminds you that mealtime difficulties in Parkinson's disease extend beyond swallowing, involving posture, utensil handling, and cognitive-attentional demands. The only two performance-based assessment tools identified are not fully validated, so you need to assess patients' overall mealtime abilities more comprehensively, not just swallowing function.
items.limitation: 仅有两项研究被纳入，且评估工具的验证证据有限，限制了对现有工具的可靠性判断。
items.limitationEn: Only two studies were included, and evidence for the validation of assessment tools is limited, restricting reliable judgment of existing instruments.

items.title: Five Days of Acute Intermittent Hypoxia Is Safe and Improves Somatic Motor Function in Persons with Multiple Sclerosis
items.summary: A randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled crossover trial in ambulatory MS patients found daily acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) was safe and significantly improved ankle plantarflexion torque (17.5% post-intervention, 29.2% at follow-up) and 6-Minute Walk Test distance (β=10.14 m, p=0.039) compared to sham.
items.curatedReason: 这项双盲交叉 RCT 首次验证了间歇性低氧（AIH）对多发性硬化症（MS）患者的安全性和疗效。AIH 显著提高了踝关节跖屈肌力（17.5% 即时改善，29.2% 随访改善）和 6 分钟步行距离，为你在 MS 康复中探索神经可塑性增强干预提供了高潜力新路径。
items.titleZh: 五天急性间歇性低氧在多发性硬化症患者中安全且可改善躯体运动功能
items.summaryZh: 一项针对可步行 MS 患者的随机、双盲、安慰剂对照交叉试验发现，每日急性间歇性低氧（AIH）安全且显著改善了踝关节跖屈肌力（干预后 17.5%，随访时 29.2%）和 6 分钟步行距离（β=10.14 m, p=0.039），相比假干预效果更优。
items.curatedReasonEn: This double-masked crossover RCT is the first to validate the safety and efficacy of acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) in persons with multiple sclerosis (MS). AIH significantly improved ankle plantarflexion torque (17.5% immediate, 29.2% at follow-up) and 6-Minute Walk Test distance, offering a high-potential new avenue for you to explore neuroplasticity-enhancing interventions in MS rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 该试验没有将 AIH 与特定的任务导向步态训练相结合，因此其协同效应尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The trial did not combine AIH with task-specific gait training, so its synergistic effects are unknown.

items.title: Final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule Has Mixed Payment Impact for Physical Therapy
items.summary: The 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule final rule includes changes to practice expense calculations expected to improve physical therapist service values over time, but also features conversion factor reductions and mixed results for remote therapeutic monitoring provisions.
items.curatedReason: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）公布的 2027 年医师收费标准最终规则，对物理治疗报销具有复杂影响。你需要仔细审查这些变化，因为它们将直接影响你的报销费率和远程治疗服务的实践。
items.titleZh: 2027 年医师收费标准最终规则对物理治疗的支付影响复杂
items.summaryZh: 2027 年医疗保险医师收费标准最终规则包括对实践支出计算的修改，预计将随着时间推移改善物理治疗服务的价值，但也包含了转换因子削减和远程治疗监测条款的复杂结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has released its final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule rule, which has complex implications for physical therapy reimbursement. You need to carefully review these changes, as they will directly impact your reimbursement rates and the practice of remote therapeutic monitoring services.

items.title: Effects of low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections on cervicogenic dizziness-related outcomes: a randomized, sham-controlled, assessor-blinded trial.
items.summary: A randomized, sham-controlled trial (n=81) found low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections improved Dizziness Handicap Inventory total scores by -6.78 points (95% CI -8.21 to -5.36; p < 0.001) more than sham, but this was below the 11-point minimal important change for cervicogenic dizziness.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射可适度改善颈源性眩晕相关的残疾，但效应量未达临床最小重要变化值。在未结合康复治疗且长期随访不足的情况下，其作为独立疗法的应用潜力有限。
items.titleZh: 低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射对颈源性眩晕相关结局的影响：一项随机、假对照、评估者盲法试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、假对照试验（n=81）发现，低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射在眩晕残疾量表总分上比假注射改善了 -6.78 分（95% CI -8.21 至 -5.36；p < 0.001），但这仍低于颈源性眩晕 11 分的最小重要临床变化值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections can modestly improve dizziness-related disability in cervicogenic dizziness, but the effect size did not reach the minimal clinically important difference. Its potential as a standalone therapy is limited without concomitant rehabilitation and longer-term follow-up.
items.limitation: 研究未验证参与者盲法，缺乏长期随访，且未与结构化康复治疗进行对比。
items.limitationEn: The study did not verify participant blinding, lacked long-term follow-up, and was not tested alongside structured rehabilitation.

items.title: Ultrasound-guided versus landmark-guided injections in musculoskeletal practice: a scoping review of clinical efficacy, educational needs, and economic considerations
items.summary: A scoping review of 29 studies found ultrasound-guided (US) injections reliably improve placement accuracy and may provide short-term symptomatic benefit at selected sites (shoulder, knee, elbow). However, comparative clinical superiority at longer follow-up and cost-effectiveness remain undetermined.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述表明，超声引导注射可可靠提高注射准确性，并在特定部位提供短期症状缓解，但长期临床优越性和成本效益尚无定论。它提醒你，在将超声引导注射常规化之前，仍需权衡患者解剖特点、临床需求和经济因素。
items.titleZh: 超声引导与体表标志引导注射在肌肉骨骼实践中的对比：临床疗效、教育需求和经济考量范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 29 项研究的范围综述发现，超声引导（US）注射可可靠地提高置入准确性，并在选定部位（肩、膝、肘）提供短期症状改善。然而，在较长随访期内的比较临床优越性和成本效益仍未确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates that ultrasound-guided injections reliably improve placement accuracy and may offer short-term symptomatic relief at selected sites, but long-term clinical superiority and cost-effectiveness are not established. It reminds you to weigh patient anatomy, clinical requirements, and economic considerations before routinely adopting ultrasound-guided injections.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学异质性高，且缺乏统一的经济学分析模型，限制了结果的综合性。
items.limitationEn: High methodological heterogeneity among included studies and a lack of uniform economic analysis models limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - CEO update to the RACS Surgical Leaders Forum
items.summary: Ahpra's CEO updated the RACS Surgical Leaders Forum on changes in healthcare regulation, emphasizing the upcoming milestone of regulating nearly one million health practitioners in Australia and New Zealand, and addressing conflicts of interest and clinical governance amid evolving business models and technology.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（Ahpra）CEO 的这份更新强调了医疗监管环境的变化，特别是对利益冲突和临床治理的关注。这提醒你必须重新审视你的执业行为和商业模式，确保符合最新的职业行为准则，以避免潜在的患者安全问题。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局——CEO 对 RACS 外科领导论坛的更新
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（Ahpra）首席执行官向皇家澳大拉西亚外科医生学院外科领导论坛通报了医疗监管的变化，强调了澳大利亚和新西兰近百万健康从业者监管的重要里程碑，并讨论了在不断变化的商业模式和技术背景下的利益冲突和临床治理问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This update from the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) CEO highlights changes in the healthcare regulatory environment, particularly regarding conflicts of interest and clinical governance. This reminds you to re-evaluate your practice and business models to ensure compliance with the latest professional conduct guidelines, to avoid potential patient safety issues.

items.title: Efficacy of real-time feedback exercise therapy in patients following total hip arthroplasty: a pilot cluster-randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot cluster-randomized controlled trial (n=22) found no statistically significant differences in functional outcomes or quality of life between real-time feedback-assisted home exercise and standard written instructions after total hip arthroplasty, though the feedback group reported higher motivation.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 表明，在全髋关节置换术后，实时反馈辅助家庭锻炼在改善功能和生活质量方面，与标准书面指导无显著差异。你的临床实践不需急于引入昂贵的实时反馈技术，传统指导仍有效。
items.titleZh: 实时反馈运动疗法对全髋关节置换术后患者的疗效：一项试点集群随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项试点集群随机对照试验（n=22）发现，在全髋关节置换术后，实时反馈辅助家庭锻炼与标准书面指导在改善功能结局和生活质量方面无统计学显著差异，尽管反馈组患者报告了更高的运动积极性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT indicates that real-time feedback-assisted home exercise did not significantly differ from standard written instructions in improving function and quality of life after total hip arthroplasty. Your clinical practice does not need to rush to adopt expensive real-time feedback technology; traditional instructions remain effective.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本（n=22）试点研究，随访时间为 6 个月，且患者盲法未经验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample (n=22) pilot study with a 6-month follow-up, and participant blinding was not verified.

items.title: e-health in musculoskeletal primary care physiotherapy: Evidence, facilitators, and barriers - A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified 45 studies on e-Health in primary care musculoskeletal physiotherapy, predominantly internet-based, mobile apps, and video consultations. It highlighted 21 facilitators and 23 barriers, emphasizing the need for clear guidelines and structured training for optimal integration.
items.curatedReason: 在基层肌肉骨骼物理治疗中，e-Health 解决方案的采纳必然要面对 21 个促进因素和 23 个障碍。这份范围综述指出，若想优化数字工具的整合，你必须提前规划清晰的指引和结构化培训。
items.titleZh: 肌肉骨骼初级物理治疗中的 e-Health：证据、促进因素和障碍——一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别了 45 项关于基层肌肉骨骼物理治疗中 e-Health 的研究，主要涉及基于互联网的解决方案、移动应用和视频咨询。综述强调了 21 项促进因素和 23 项障碍，并指出需要明确的指南和结构化培训以实现最佳整合。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adopting e-Health solutions in primary care musculoskeletal physiotherapy will inevitably face 21 facilitators and 23 barriers. This scoping review highlights that to optimize the integration of digital tools, you must plan for clear guidelines and structured training upfront.
items.limitation: 研究方法和 e-Health 模式的异质性、高收入国家研究的主导地位以及技术快速发展限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity of study methods and e-Health modalities, the predominance of studies from high-income countries, and rapid technological advancement limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Integrated Decision-Making Under Uncertainty in High-Performance Sport Support Systems
items.summary: A narrative review proposes a framework for integrated decision-making in high-performance sport support systems, combining established decision principles with qualitative triage. It outlines five interdependent functions for integrated work and emphasizes athlete values, decision rights, and coaches' roles.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述为高水平运动支持系统中的决策制定提供了一个框架，强调了在不确定性下整合证据和专业判断的重要性。它能帮助你优化你的跨学科协作方式，更好地将科学推理应用于运动员的康复与表现管理。
items.titleZh: 高水平运动支持系统中不确定性下的整合决策 | 运动医学 - 开放
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述提出了一种高水平运动支持系统中整合决策的框架，结合了既定的决策原则和定性分类。它概述了整合工作的五个相互依赖的功能，并强调了运动员价值观、决策权和教练角色的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: In high-performance sport support systems, you need to integrate established decision principles with qualitative triage, rather than relying on a single model. The framework provided by this review can help you optimize interdisciplinary collaboration and better integrate evidence with professional judgment under uncertainty.
items.limitation: 该框架仍是概念性的，其内容效度、可用性、分类一致性、实施负担和决策过程仍需进一步评估。
items.limitationEn: The framework remains conceptual, and its content validity, usability, triage consistency, implementation burden, and decision processes require further evaluation.

items.title: Routine physical function assessment may identify older adults at increased risk of dementia years before diagnosis
items.summary: A commentary on a nested case-control study (Age Ageing 2026;55(4):afag062) suggests that routine assessment of gait speed, grip strength, and frailty may identify older adults at increased risk of dementia years before diagnosis, advocating for their inclusion in longitudinal monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 日常体能评估（如步速、握力和衰弱程度）不仅关乎身体健康，也可能预示认知功能。这项述评提示你，将这些评估纳入对老年人的常规监测，有望在痴呆诊断前数年识别高风险个体，为早期干预或延缓认知衰退争取时间。
items.titleZh: 常规身体功能评估或可在痴呆诊断前数年识别患病风险增加的老年人
items.summaryZh: 一项对巢式病例对照研究（Age Ageing 2026;55(4):afag062）的述评指出，常规评估步速、握力和衰弱程度可能在痴呆诊断前数年识别出患病风险增加的老年人，并倡导将其纳入长期监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Routine physical function assessments (e.g., gait speed, grip strength, and frailty) are not only about physical health but may also predict cognitive function. This commentary suggests incorporating these assessments into routine monitoring of older adults, potentially identifying high-risk individuals years before a dementia diagnosis, allowing time for early intervention or delaying cognitive decline.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评文章，而非原始研究，因此其结论是基于对现有证据的解读。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary rather than an original research study, so its conclusions are based on an interpretation of existing evidence.

items.title:
Stakeholder priorities for rehabilitation to support functioning at home and work among people on sick leave due to low back pain: a group concept mapping study
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A group concept mapping study (n=101) identified six stakeholder-prioritized clusters for low back pain rehabilitation for people on sick leave: self-management, physical training, workplace involvement, interdisciplinary coordination, individual support, and extended assessment. All clusters received high importance ratings.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究清晰地界定了因腰痛病假人群对康复的优先需求，涵盖了自我管理、体能训练、工作场所参与等六大集群。它强调了以患者为中心、跨部门协调的康复模式，能够指导你优化对这类患者的综合康复策略，促进他们重返家庭和工作。
items.titleZh: 因腰痛请病假人群的康复利益相关者优先事项，以支持居家和工作功能：一项团体概念图研究
items.summaryZh: 一项团体概念图研究（n=101）确定了因腰痛请病假人群的六个利益相关者优先康复集群：自我管理、体能训练、工作场所参与、跨学科协调、个体支持和扩展评估。所有集群均获得高度重要性评价。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study clearly defines the rehabilitation priorities for people on sick leave due to low back pain, covering six clusters including self-management, physical training, and workplace involvement. It emphasizes patient-centered, cross-sectoral coordinated rehabilitation models, which can guide you in optimizing comprehensive rehabilitation strategies for these patients, promoting their return to home and work.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且参与者仅来自丹麦，结果的普适性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size, and participants were only from Denmark, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: The MSK Playbook: Hamstring Strain Injuries - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: A BJSM blog post reviews hamstring strain injuries, their increasing incidence (24% of all professional football injuries) and high recurrence rates (over 30%). It covers injury mechanisms, biomechanics, imaging, and rehab protocols for this common sports injury.
items.curatedReason: 腘绳肌拉伤的发生率已占职业足球所有损伤的 24%，复发率更超 30%，这表明现有康复方案仍有不足。这份博客文章提供了一个全面框架，你可以用它来审视自己的康复协议，尤其是在理解损伤机制和避免再次损伤方面。
items.titleZh: MSK 攻略：腘绳肌拉伤
items.summaryZh: 一篇 BJSM 博客文章回顾了腘绳肌拉伤，指出其发病率不断上升（占职业橄榄球所有损伤的 24%），复发率高（超过 30%）。文章涵盖了这种常见运动损伤的损伤机制、生物力学、影像学和康复方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: Hamstring strain injuries account for 24% of all professional football injuries, with recurrence rates exceeding 30%, indicating deficiencies in current rehabilitation protocols. This blog post offers a comprehensive framework you can use to scrutinize your own rehab protocols, especially regarding injury mechanisms and preventing re-injury.

items.title: Altered Cognitive Control and Cortical Oscillatory Dynamics in Athletes With ACL Reconstruction During Decision-Making Under Uncertainty.
items.summary: A controlled laboratory study of 90 open-skill athletes (45 non-ACLR, 45 ACLR) found ACLR athletes showed slower response times, lower accuracy, and altered cortical oscillatory dynamics (attenuated prestimulus theta, elevated target phase theta, reduced beta/alpha suppression) during a probabilistic go/no-go task.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后运动员中普遍存在的神经认知改变，尤其是在不确定性决策下的认知控制和皮层振荡动态变化，提示了重返运动评估需超越传统体能指标，考虑整合神经认知评估来识别复伤风险。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后运动员在不确定性决策中认知控制和皮层振荡动态的改变
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 90 名开放技能运动员（45 名无 ACL 损伤，45 名 ACL 重建）的对照实验室研究发现，ACL 重建组在不确定性决策任务中表现出较慢的反应时间、较低的准确性，以及皮层振荡动态的改变（前刺激期 theta 减弱，目标期 theta 升高，beta/alpha 抑制减少）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The persistent neurocognitive alterations in ACLR athletes, particularly in cognitive control and cortical oscillatory dynamics during decision-making under uncertainty, suggest that return-to-sport assessments should expand beyond traditional physical metrics to include neurocognitive evaluations for reinjury risk identification.
items.limitation: 本研究的观察性设计无法建立因果关系，并且对不同运动类型或 ACLR 术后阶段的泛化能力可能有限。
items.limitationEn: The observational design of this study cannot establish causality, and generalizability to different sport types or post-ACLR phases may be limited.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Efficacy of Manual Physiotherapy Techniques for Improving Cervical Range of Motion in Infants With Congenital Muscular Torticollis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of five RCTs (n=143 infants) found manual physiotherapy techniques significantly improved cervical ROM in infants with congenital muscular torticollis (Cohen's d = 0.90, 95% CI: 0.54 to 1.27, p < 0.001), indicating a large overall effect with low heterogeneity.
items.curatedReason: 手法治疗在改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈部活动度方面，短期效果显著且证据坚实。在临床实践中，你应该将其作为这类婴儿早期干预的一线选择。
items.titleZh: 手法物理治疗技术改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈椎活动度的疗效：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对五项 RCT（143 名婴儿）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，手法物理治疗技术能显著改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿的颈椎活动度（Cohen's d = 0.90，95% CI：0.54 至 1.27，p < 0.001），显示出较大的总体效应且异质性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Manual therapy demonstrably improves cervical ROM in infants with congenital muscular torticollis in the short term, with strong evidence from this review. You should confidently position it as a first-line intervention for these infants in early clinical practice.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量较少（5 项 RCTs），且干预方案存在异质性，目前尚缺乏长期随访数据支持。
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis included a small number of studies (5 RCTs), showed variability in intervention protocols, and lacked long-term follow-up data.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Machine Learning Prediction of Independent Walking 8 Weeks After Rehabilitation in Patients With Stroke: A Retrospective Study.
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study of 169 stroke patients found machine learning models, especially neural networks, provided good discrimination (AUCs 0.839-0.884) for predicting independent walking 8 weeks post-rehabilitation, with BBS and SEP severity being leading predictors.
items.curatedReason: 预测卒中后 8 周独立行走能力对康复计划至关重要。该研究提示机器学习模型结合临床和躯体感觉指标，预测准确性优于传统方法，有助于早期分层和干预。
items.titleZh: 机器学习预测卒中患者康复后 8 周的独立行走能力：一项回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 169 名卒中患者的单中心回顾性队列研究发现，机器学习模型，特别是神经网络，在预测康复后 8 周独立行走方面表现出良好的区分能力（AUC 0.839-0.884），其中 BBS 和 SEP 严重程度是主要预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: Predicting independent walking ability 8 weeks post-stroke is crucial for rehabilitation planning. This study suggests that machine learning models, integrating clinical and somatosensory measures, offer superior predictive accuracy compared to conventional methods, aiding early stratification and intervention.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性队列研究，且缺乏外部验证，结果尚不能直接应用于临床。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center retrospective cohort study lacking external validation, so the findings cannot be directly applied clinically yet.

items.title: Diagnosis, Rehabilitation, and Return to Sport after Athletic Hamstring Injury: An ICCUS Society Consensus Statement.
items.summary: An ICCUS Society expert consensus statement, developed via a modified Delphi process with 17 clinicians, achieved over 80% agreement on 54 statements concerning athletic hamstring injury management, emphasizing standardized classification, individualized criterion-based rehabilitation, progressive loading, and multi-faceted return-to-sport criteria.
items.curatedReason: 这份由17位专家达成80%以上共识的声明，为腘绳肌损伤管理提供了明确的指导方针。这意味着你应当推行标准化的分类、个性化且基于标准的康复方案，并采用多维度评估来决定运动员何时重返赛场。
items.titleZh: 运动性腘绳肌损伤的诊断、康复和重返运动：ICCUS学会共识声明
items.summaryZh: 一份由17位临床专家通过改良德尔菲法制定的ICCUS学会共识声明，在运动性腘绳肌损伤管理的54项声明上达成80%以上共识，强调了标准化分类、个体化基于标准的康复、渐进式负荷以及多方面重返运动标准的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This consensus, agreed upon by 17 experts with over 80% concordance, offers clear guidelines for hamstring injury management. You should adopt standardized classification, implement individualized and criterion-based rehabilitation, and utilize multi-faceted assessments for return-to-sport decisions.
items.limitation: 德尔菲共识依赖于专家意见，而非直接的随机对照试验数据，可能存在专家组自身偏倚。
items.limitationEn: Delphi consensus relies on expert opinions rather than direct randomized controlled trial data, which may introduce bias from the expert panel itself.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Gait variability as a predictor of fall risk in patients with stroke: A 6-month prospective cohort study with survival analysis.
items.summary: In a 6-month prospective cohort study of 112 stroke patients, stride time variability (STV) at discharge, with an optimal cutoff of 3.40% (AUC 0.756, sensitivity 88.2%, specificity 53.8%), was identified as the sole independent predictor of post-discharge falls, outperforming conventional measures.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究表明，卒中患者出院时的步幅时间变异性（STV）是预测其出院后6个月内跌倒风险的独立指标，其3.40%的截断值可辅助早期风险识别。这提示你在临床实践中应常规评估STV，并对高风险患者实施有针对性的跌倒预防干预。
items.titleZh: 步态变异性作为卒中患者跌倒风险预测指标：一项6个月随访的队列研究和生存分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对112名卒中患者进行6个月随访的前瞻性队列研究显示，出院时的步幅时间变异性（STV），以3.40%为最佳截断值（AUC 0.756，敏感性88.2%，特异性53.8%），是出院后跌倒的唯一独立预测因子，优于其他常规测量指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study indicates that stride time variability (STV) at discharge is an independent predictor of fall risk within 6 months post-discharge for stroke patients, with a 3.40% cutoff value aiding early risk identification. This suggests you should routinely assess STV in clinical practice and implement targeted fall prevention interventions for high-risk patients.
items.limitation: 该研究为单中心样本，可能限制了STV截断值的普适性，需要多中心验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's single-center sample may limit the generalizability of the STV cutoff value, requiring multi-center validation.

items.title: Neurocognitive Factors in ACL Injury: The Missing Piece in Rehabilitation and Prevention? A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 42 studies identified neurocognitive factors, particularly dual-task interference and visual attention, as significant missing components in ACL injury rehabilitation and prevention. It suggests integrating neurocognitive challenges into rehabilitation and return-to-sport testing to better identify secondary injury risk.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述强调了神经认知因素在ACL损伤康复和预防中被忽视的重要性。你需要在康复和重返运动测试中更多地融入双任务干扰、视觉注意、反应时间等神经认知挑战，以更好地识别二次损伤风险。
items.titleZh: ACL损伤中的神经认知因素：康复和预防中缺失的一环？一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含42项研究的范围综述指出，神经认知因素，特别是双任务干扰和视觉注意，是ACL损伤康复和预防中被忽视的重要组成部分。该综述建议将神经认知挑战融入康复和重返运动测试，以更好地识别二次损伤风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review highlights the overlooked importance of neurocognitive factors in ACL injury rehabilitation and prevention. You need to integrate neurocognitive challenges like dual-task interference, visual attention, and reaction time more into rehabilitation and return-to-sport testing to better identify risks for secondary injury.
items.limitation: 这是一篇范围综述，纳入的研究证据等级较低，多为实验室探索性研究，临床转化数据有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, and the included studies often have a low level of evidence, consisting mostly of exploratory lab-based research with limited clinical translational data.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Feasibility, Safety, and Preliminary Effect Estimates of an Ultrasound-Informed Hybrid Joint-Sparing Rehabilitation Strategy in Patients With Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Prospective Non-Randomized Proof-of-Concept Study.
items.summary: A 12-week ultrasound-informed hybrid rehabilitation protocol for rheumatoid arthritis was found feasible and safe in 60 patients, showing greater pain reduction (ΔVAS: -2.88 cm vs. -0.60 cm; p < 0.001) than a control group, though effect sizes may be overestimated and specific ultrasound attribution was limited.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究提示，超声引导下的类风湿关节炎康复方案是安全且可行的。不过，目前的疼痛改善效应可能被高估了，且超声引导的实际增益还需要更严谨的RCT来验证。
items.titleZh: 超声引导的混合关节保护康复策略对类风湿关节炎患者的可行性、安全性和初步效果：一项前瞻性非随机概念验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入60例类风湿关节炎患者的12周超声引导混合康复方案，显示出可行性和安全性，且疼痛缓解优于对照组（ΔVAS：-2.88 cm vs. -0.60 cm; p < 0.001），但研究者指出效应量可能被高估，且超声引导的具体作用难以归因。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-concept study suggests that ultrasound-informed rehabilitation for rheumatoid arthritis is safe and feasible. However, the reported pain improvement may be overestimated, and the actual benefit of ultrasound guidance requires more rigorous RCTs.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本、单中心、非随机研究，且未预设可行性标准，可能导致效应量高估和非特异性接触效应。
items.limitationEn: This was a small, single-center, non-randomized study without prespecified feasibility criteria, potentially leading to overestimated effect sizes and non-specific contact effects.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Walking Capacity and Daily Movement Behaviours After Ischemic Stroke: A Potential Capacity-Performance Gap.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of ambulatory ischemic stroke patients found a capacity-performance gap: participants accumulated ~12 hours/day of sedentary time despite walking speeds approaching community ambulation, with gait speed being the only walking capacity measure associated with daily movement behaviors.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，卒中患者的步行能力与日常活动之间存在“能力-表现差距”，即使步行速度接近社区行走标准，仍可能长时间久坐。它提示你在评估时需要同时关注步态能力和实际的日常活动模式，并针对久坐行为进行干预。
items.titleZh: 缺血性卒中后的步行能力和日常活动行为：潜在的能力-表现差距
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入可步行的缺血性卒中患者的横断面研究发现，即使患者步行速度接近社区行走标准，每天仍有约12小时的久坐时间，存在能力-表现差距；步态速度是唯一与日常活动行为相关的步行能力指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals a "capacity-performance gap" in stroke patients, where walking capacity may not translate to daily activity, with prolonged sedentary time despite near-community walking speeds. It suggests the need to assess both gait capacity and actual daily movement patterns, and to intervene on sedentary behavior.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, unable to establish causality, and its small sample size may limit generalizability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Feasibility and Preliminary Effects of Oropharyngeal Alignment Exercise on Swallowing Function in Neurological Disorders with Restricted Mouth Opening: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A pilot study with 9 participants (7 stroke, 1 Parkinson's) found oropharyngeal alignment exercise feasible and well-tolerated for neurological dysphagia and restricted mouth opening, showing preliminary improvements in maximum mouth opening (6-13 mm), MASA, GUSS, and PAS scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究为口咽对齐运动治疗神经系统疾病导致的吞咽困难提供了可行性证据。在等待更大型随机对照试验的同时，你可以考虑将其作为常规康复的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 口咽对齐运动对限制性张口神经系统疾病吞咽功能的可行性和初步效果：一项预试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入9名神经系统疾病患者（7名卒中，1名帕金森病）的预试验显示，口咽对齐运动治疗吞咽困难和限制性张口是可行且耐受良好的，并在最大张口度（增加6-13毫米）、MASA、GUSS和PAS评分上观察到初步改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study provides feasibility evidence for oropharyngeal alignment exercise in treating dysphagia caused by neurological disorders. While awaiting larger RCTs, you may consider it as an adjunct to routine rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本单臂初步研究，缺乏对照组，无法确证治疗效果，且诊断人群异质性较高。
items.limitationEn: This was a small, single-arm pilot study lacking a control group, precluding definitive conclusions on treatment efficacy, and with high diagnostic heterogeneity.

items.title: Neurorehabilitation as an Opportunity for Structured Post-Stroke Lipid Management: A Narrative Review.
items.summary: This narrative review suggests neurorehabilitation settings may facilitate optimized lipid management post-ischemic stroke by integrating medication titration, adherence monitoring, and risk stratification, despite a lack of direct rehabilitation-based randomized trials.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后血脂管理对二级预防至关重要。这篇综述提醒我们，康复住院期间是整合药物优化、依从性监测和风险分层的宝贵机会，有助于弥合急性期与长期管理之间的差距。
items.titleZh: 神经康复：卒中后结构化血脂管理的机会：一篇叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述指出，尽管缺乏直接的康复随机试验，但神经康复环境可以通过整合药物调整、依从性监测和风险分层，促进缺血性卒中后的血脂优化管理。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-stroke lipid management is critical for secondary prevention. This review highlights that neurorehabilitation hospitalization offers a valuable opportunity to integrate medication optimization, adherence monitoring, and risk stratification, helping to bridge the gap between acute and long-term management.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且缺乏直接康复干预的RCT证据来支持其整合策略。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias and lacks direct rehabilitation-based RCT evidence to support its integrated strategies.

items.title: Beyond Reconstruction: Return to Olympic Medal Performance Following Morphology-Informed and Criterion-Based Nonoperative Management of a Femoral-Sided Sherman Type II ACL Injury - A Case Report.
items.summary: An elite field hockey player with a femoral-sided Sherman type II ACL injury successfully returned to Olympic medal performance (silver, 200 days post-injury) via morphology-informed nonoperative management and criterion-based rehabilitation, challenging the necessity of reconstruction for select ACL phenotypes.
items.curatedReason: 这例精英运动员ACL损伤非手术康复并重返奥运赛场的报告，挑战了传统上认为高水平运动员必须手术重建的观念。它提示我们，对于特定损伤类型（股骨侧Sherman II型）和选择的患者，以形态学信息和客观标准指导的非手术康复可能是可行的路径。
items.titleZh: 超越重建：股骨侧Sherman II型ACL损伤经形态学指导和基于标准的非手术管理后重返奥运奖牌表现——一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名精英曲棍球运动员在股骨侧Sherman II型ACL损伤后，通过形态学指导的非手术管理和基于标准的康复，成功重返奥运赛场并获得银牌（伤后200天），挑战了部分ACL损伤类型必须进行重建的传统观念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report of an elite athlete returning to Olympic performance after nonoperative ACL management challenges the traditional view that high-level athletes invariably require surgical reconstruction. It suggests that for specific injury types (femoral-sided Sherman Type II) and selected patients, morphology-informed, criterion-based nonoperative rehabilitation may be a viable pathway.
items.limitation: 这是一篇单例报告，证据等级低，结果不具普遍性，不能直接推及所有ACL损伤或精英运动员。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with a low level of evidence, and its findings are not generalizable to all ACL injuries or elite athletes.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Validation of Video-based Motion Capture for Lower Body and Trunk Kinematics with Marker Augmentation
items.summary: A study validated video-based motion capture with marker augmentation for lower body and trunk kinematics, suggesting its potential as a low-cost, non-invasive tool for movement analysis.
items.curatedReason: 视频捕捉技术结合标记物增强，在下肢和躯干运动学评估中显示出准确性，这提示我们，低成本、非侵入性的运动分析工具可能很快就能进入临床。在考虑购置昂贵设备前，不妨关注这类技术的成熟度。
items.titleZh: 带标记增强的视频运动捕捉技术在下肢和躯干运动学中的验证
items.summaryZh: 一项研究验证了带标记增强的视频运动捕捉技术在下肢和躯干运动学分析中的准确性，提示了其作为低成本、非侵入性运动分析工具的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Video-based motion capture with marker augmentation shows promise for accurate lower body and trunk kinematics. This suggests low-cost, non-invasive movement analysis tools might soon be viable for clinical use. Before investing in expensive equipment, keep an eye on how these technologies mature.
items.limitation: 该研究的局限性在于可能仅在特定实验室条件下进行验证，其在真实临床环境中的普适性和操作便捷性仍需进一步评估。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this study is that validation may have been conducted only under specific laboratory conditions, and its generalizability and operational convenience in real clinical settings still require further evaluation.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Healthcare professionals' perceptions and experiences of promoting physical activity in persons with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review of qualitative evidence.
items.summary: A systematic review of eight qualitative studies identified healthcare professional-based, organizational, social, and patient-related factors influencing physical activity promotion in persons with multiple sclerosis. Findings suggest improving promotion requires MS-specific education for professionals, practical resources, and stronger cross-sector coordination.
items.curatedReason: 这篇系统综述揭示了医疗专业人员在促进多发性硬化症患者身体活动方面的障碍和促进因素。它强调了需要针对MS的教育和培训、患者教育材料以及跨部门协调，以更有效地推广身体活动。
items.titleZh: 医疗专业人员促进多发性硬化症患者身体活动的感知和经验：定性证据的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对8项定性研究的系统综述发现，影响多发性硬化症患者身体活动推广的因素包括医疗专业人员、组织、社会和患者相关因素。研究结果表明，改进推广需要针对专业人员的MS特异性教育、实用资源以及更强的跨部门协调。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights barriers and facilitators for healthcare professionals in promoting physical activity for MS patients. It underscores the need for MS-specific education and training, patient education materials, and cross-sector coordination to improve physical activity promotion.
items.limitation: 本综述仅纳入定性研究，无法提供量化干预效果的证据。
items.limitationEn: This review only included qualitative studies, limiting its ability to quantify intervention effects.

items.title: Adherence System Usability Patient Experience and Psychosocial Impact in Robot Assisted Gait Neurorehabilitation A Cross Sectional Study.
items.summary: This observational study of 250 adults in robot-assisted gait neurorehabilitation found that greater attendance, system usability, and rehabilitation experience were associated with favorable psychosocial impact (r s = 0.41 to 0.53, all p < 0.001). This association remained significant after adjusting for diagnosis, age, sex, and disease duration.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了在机器人辅助步态神经康复中，患者的依从性、系统可用性和康复体验对社会心理影响至关重要。你应关注这些因素，以优化患者康复效果和满意度。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态神经康复中依从系统可用性、患者体验与社会心理影响：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项对250名接受机器人辅助步态神经康复的成年人进行的观察性研究发现，更高的出勤率、系统可用性和康复体验与积极的社会心理影响相关（r s = 0.41至0.53，均 p < 0.001）。在调整了诊断、年龄、性别和疾病持续时间后，这种关联仍然显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that patient adherence, system usability, and rehabilitation experience are crucial for psychosocial impact in robot-assisted gait neurorehabilitation. You should focus on these factors to optimize patient outcomes and satisfaction.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性研究，存在诊断异质性，同时进行问卷评估，且与出勤率存在时间错配，限制了因果推断。
items.limitationEn: This single-center observational study has diagnostic heterogeneity, simultaneous questionnaire assessment, and a temporal mismatch with attendance, limiting causal inference.

items.title: Gamified Versus Traditional Balance Training: Effects on Balance and Motivation in Collegiate Student-Athletes.
items.summary: In this quasi-experimental controlled trial, 30 collegiate athletes (19.8 ± 0.9 years) were pseudo-randomized to gamified (Wii Fit, n=9), traditional (wobble board, n=11) balance training, or control (n=10). Both training groups showed significant improvements in mSEBT anterior reach (+6.5 cm) and composite scores (+21.6 cm for gamified, +18.5 cm for traditional) compared to control (p < 0.01). Gamified training yielded higher IMI interest/enjoyment scores (5.0 ± 1.2 vs. 3.2 ± 1.3; p < 0.01, d = 1.50).
items.curatedReason: 该 RCT 证实，游戏化平衡训练在改善大学运动员动态平衡方面与传统训练同样有效，且能显著提升训练乐趣。这意味着你可以将游戏化平台纳入康复和损伤预防计划，以提高依从性和参与度。
items.titleZh: 游戏化与传统平衡训练：对大学学生运动员平衡能力和动机的影响
items.summaryZh: 在这项准实验性对照试验中，30名大学运动员（19.8 ± 0.9岁）被假随机分配至游戏化（Wii Fit，n=9）、传统（摇摆板，n=11）平衡训练组或对照组（n=10）。与对照组相比，两个训练组在mSEBT前向触及（+6.5厘米）和综合评分（游戏化组+21.6厘米，传统组+18.5厘米）方面均有显著改善（p < 0.01）。游戏化训练组的内在动机量表（IMI）兴趣/享受得分更高（5.0 ± 1.2 vs. 3.2 ± 1.3；p < 0.01，d = 1.50）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that gamified balance training is as effective as traditional training in improving dynamic balance in collegiate athletes, while significantly boosting enjoyment. This means you can incorporate gamified platforms into rehabilitation and injury prevention programs to enhance adherence and engagement.
items.limitation: 本研究为准实验性对照试验，并非随机对照，且样本量相对较小（30名运动员），可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This quasi-experimental controlled trial, not an RCT, has a relatively small sample size (30 athletes) and may be subject to selection bias.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Ultrasound-Guided Percutaneous Tendon Dry Needling for Recalcitrant Distal Biceps Tendinopathy: A Case Series.
items.summary: This case series describes two subjects with chronic distal biceps tendinopathy treated with ultrasound-guided percutaneous tendon dry needling and a graded loading program. Both subjects showed clinically important improvements in pain and function at 5 weeks and 6 months, with observable tendon healing.
items.curatedReason: 本案例系列提示超声引导下的干针配合负重训练可能有助于慢性远端肱二头肌肌腱病。但只有两个病例，还远不足以改变你的临床实践。
items.titleZh: 超声引导经皮肌腱干针治疗难治性远端肱二头肌肌腱病：病例系列报告
items.summaryZh: 本病例系列报告描述了两名慢性远端肱二头肌肌腱病患者，经超声引导经皮肌腱干针联合分级负重计划治疗。两名患者在5周和6个月时疼痛和功能均有临床显著改善，并观察到肌腱愈合特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series suggests ultrasound-guided dry needling combined with a loading program may aid chronic distal biceps tendinopathy. However, with only two cases, it's far from practice-changing.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例系列，样本量仅2例，证据等级低，无法推断普遍有效性。
items.limitationEn: This case series has a sample size of only two, providing low-level evidence with limited generalizability.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Effects of Medium-frequency Electrical Stimulation Combined with Near-Infrared Light on Quadriceps Function and Independent Walking in Patients with Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A two-phase study found individuals with SCI had less quadriceps electromyographic activation and impaired deep femoral artery hemodynamics compared to healthy controls. In Phase II, 18 SCI participants (n=9/group) receiving medium-frequency electrical stimulation plus near-infrared light with conventional rehabilitation showed within-group improvements across all outcomes, with significant inter-group differences in right peak systolic velocity and walking ability.
items.curatedReason: 对于脊髓损伤患者，中频电刺激联合近红外光可能有助于改善股四头肌激活和步行能力。但请注意，这是一项小样本的观察研究，初步结果提示了联合治疗的潜力，但尚不足以改变当前的临床实践。
items.titleZh: 中频电刺激联合近红外光对脊髓损伤患者股四头肌功能及独立行走能力的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段研究发现，脊髓损伤患者与健康对照组相比，股四头肌肌电活动较少，深股动脉血流动力学受损。在第二阶段，18名脊髓损伤患者（每组9人）接受中频电刺激联合近红外光和常规康复治疗，所有评估指标均有组内改善，右侧收缩峰值速度和步行能力有显著组间差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with SCI, combining medium-frequency electrical stimulation and near-infrared light may help improve quadriceps activation and walking ability. However, this was a small observational study; while preliminary results suggest potential for this combined therapy, it's not yet strong enough to alter current clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为非随机对照预-后干预研究，样本量小（18例），且未包含其他下肢肌肉和血管区域的评估，结果尚需更大规模随机研究证实。
items.limitationEn: This non-randomized, controlled pre-post-intervention study has a small sample size (18 cases) and did not assess other lower-limb muscles or vascular territories, requiring larger randomized studies for confirmation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Development of a Single-Camera Markerless Motion Capture System for Assessing Upper Limb Function Post-Stroke (FULMA).
items.summary: This prospective observational study developed and evaluated FULMA, a single-camera markerless motion capture system for post-stroke upper limb function. In 39 stroke participants, machine learning models achieved a mean accuracy of 83.3% (weighted kappa 0.67-0.88) in predicting task performance scores compared to occupational therapist ratings, showing preliminary agreement.
items.curatedReason: FULMA 系统提供了一种评估卒中后上肢功能的无标记运动捕捉工具，其自动化评分与治疗师评估初步一致。这提示了在临床实践中使用这类客观测量的潜力，能提高评估的一致性和敏感性。
items.titleZh: 开发用于评估卒中后上肢功能的单摄像头无标记运动捕捉系统 (FULMA)
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性观察研究开发并评估了FULMA，一个用于卒中后上肢功能的单摄像头无标记运动捕捉系统。在39名卒中参与者中，机器学习模型在预测任务表现评分方面与职业治疗师评分的平均准确度达到83.3%（加权Kappa 0.67-0.88），显示出初步的一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The FULMA system offers a markerless motion capture tool for assessing upper limb function post-stroke, showing preliminary agreement between automated scores and therapist ratings. This highlights the potential of objective measures in clinical practice to improve assessment consistency and sensitivity.
items.limitation: 本研究为早期开发阶段的观察性研究，在受控环境下进行，需要外部验证和更全面的测量特性评估才能用于临床。
items.limitationEn: This is an early-stage observational development study conducted in a controlled setting, requiring external validation and comprehensive measurement property evaluation before clinical use.

items.title: Conservative and Post-Operative Rehabilitation Protocols for Hip Dysplasia in Adolescents to Adulthood: A Literature Review.
items.summary: This literature review of 12 sources examined conservative and post-operative rehabilitation protocols for hip dysplasia in adolescents and adults (13-50 years). It found that physiotherapy, especially multimodal, criterion-based approaches incorporating progressive strengthening and neuromuscular retraining, is a central component.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文献综述确认了物理治疗在青少年和成人髋关节发育不良保守及术后康复中的核心地位。尽管证据质量不高，但它强调了多模式、基于标准的渐进性强化和神经肌肉再训练方案的重要性。
items.titleZh: 青少年至成年髋关节发育不良的保守与术后康复方案：文献综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇文献综述审查了12个来源，探讨了青少年和成人（13-50岁）髋关节发育不良的保守和术后康复方案。研究发现，物理治疗，特别是多模式、基于标准的渐进性强化和神经肌肉再训练方法，是核心组成部分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This literature review confirms the central role of physical therapy in both conservative and post-operative rehabilitation for adolescent and adult hip dysplasia. Despite limitations in evidence quality, it highlights the importance of multimodal, criterion-based progressive strengthening and neuromuscular retraining programs.
items.limitation: 本综述的证据基础受限于方法学异质性、小样本量和对专家共识的依赖，缺乏高质量的比较试验。
items.limitationEn: The evidence base of this review is limited by methodological heterogeneity, small sample sizes, and reliance on expert consensus, with no high-quality comparative trials identified.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Can traditional Chinese exercises help people with musculoskeletal disorders? - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: An umbrella review of 92 meta-analyses of RCTs found high-certainty evidence that traditional Chinese exercises improved physical function and mental health in knee osteoarthritis, mental health in neck pain, and sleep quality in fibromyalgia, with Tai Chi showing the most consistent benefits.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述有力支持了将传统中医运动（如太极、八段锦）纳入肌肉骨骼疾病常规治疗的价值，尤其对膝骨关节炎、颈痛和纤维肌痛的身体功能、心理健康及睡眠质量有确凿证据。这为你向患者推荐低冲击运动方案提供了高级别循证支持。
items.titleZh: 传统中医运动能否帮助肌肉骨骼疾病患者？
items.summaryZh: 一项对92项RCTs荟萃分析的伞形综述发现，有高度确定性证据表明，传统中医运动可改善膝骨关节炎患者的身体功能和心理健康、颈痛患者的心理健康以及纤维肌痛患者的睡眠质量，其中太极拳效果最一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review strongly supports the value of incorporating traditional Chinese exercises (e.g., Tai Chi, Baduanjin) into routine care for musculoskeletal disorders, with high-certainty evidence for physical function, mental health, and sleep quality in knee osteoarthritis, neck pain, and fibromyalgia. This provides high-level evidence for recommending low-impact exercise options to patients.
items.limitation: 伞形综述的局限性在于其纳入的原始研究和系统综述可能存在异质性，且部分结局的证据确定性仍为中等。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of an umbrella review lies in the potential heterogeneity of its included primary studies and systematic reviews, and the certainty of evidence for some outcomes remains moderate.

items.title: CMS Posts Bidder Licensure Guide for Round 2028 of the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program & Updates to HCPCS Level II Code Classifications for Certain Leg and Arm Braces | DCBPS Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics and Supplies (DMEPOS) Competitive Bidding Program
items.summary: CMS has posted the Round 2028 Bidder Licensure Guide for the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program and updated HCPCS Level II code classifications for certain leg and arm braces, effective December 1, 2026, reclassifying L1833, L1851, L1852, and L3761 from off-the-shelf to requiring professional fitting.
items.curatedReason: CMS发布了2028年DMEPOS竞标项目（CBP）的投标者执照指南，并更新了部分腿臂矫形器的HCPCS Level II编码分类，明确这些矫形器不再符合“现成”定义，需要由专业人员适配。这直接影响DMEPOS供应商的投标策略和PT/OT执业者选择和报销相关矫形器的实践。
items.titleZh: CMS发布2028年DMEPOS竞标项目投标者执照指南并更新部分腿臂矫形器HCPCS Level II编码分类
items.summaryZh: CMS发布了2028年DMEPOS竞标项目的投标者执照指南，并更新了部分腿臂矫形器的HCPCS Level II编码分类，自2026年12月1日起，将L1833、L1851、L1852和L3761从“现成”重新分类为需专业人员适配。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released the Round 2028 Bidder Licensure Guide for the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program (CBP) and updated HCPCS Level II code classifications for certain leg and arm braces, clarifying that these braces no longer meet the “off-the-shelf” definition and require fitting by a qualified professional. This directly impacts DMEPOS suppliers' bidding strategies and the practice of PT/OT professionals in selecting and billing for these braces.

items.title: Comparison of Radiofrequency Microtenotomy vs. Heavy-Slow Resistance for Refractory Plantar Fasciopathy: A Randomised Controlled Trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=72) found no significant difference in FHSQ-DK pain domain mean change from baseline to 6 months between radiofrequency microtenotomy and heavy-slow resistance training for refractory plantar fasciopathy (mean difference −4.9, 95% CI −13.8; 4.0).
items.curatedReason: 对于顽固性足底筋膜病，这项RCT明确指出射频微切开术并不优于重慢速抗阻训练。这意味着对这类患者，运动疗法应作为首选干预，避免不必要的微创手术。
items.titleZh: 射频微切开术与重慢速抗阻训练治疗顽固性足底筋膜病的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=72）显示，对于顽固性足底筋膜病，射频微切开术与重慢速抗阻训练在6个月时FHSQ-DK疼痛域的平均变化无显著差异（平均差−4.9，95% CI −13.8; 4.0）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For refractory plantar fasciopathy, this RCT clearly indicates that radiofrequency microtenotomy is not superior to heavy-slow resistance training. This suggests that exercise therapy should be the preferred intervention for these patients, avoiding unnecessary minimally invasive surgery.
items.limitation: 该研究的随访时间为6个月，未能评估长期疗效；且部分患者退出可能影响了最终分析的精确性。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was 6 months, not allowing for long-term efficacy assessment, and patient dropouts may have affected the precision of the final analysis.

items.title: Radiographic quantification of active self-correction during physiotherapeutic scoliosis-specific exercises and its potential prognostic value in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
items.summary: A prospective study (n=not specified) found that active self-correction during physiotherapeutic scoliosis-specific exercises (PSSE) resulted in 27.32% Cobb angle correction (from 37.57° to 28.82°) and was the only variable significantly associated with 6-month post-treatment Cobb angle change.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性研究首次放射学量化了特发性脊柱侧凸患者在PSSE训练中的主动自我矫正（ASC）程度，并发现其与6个月后的Cobb角变化相关。这提示在临床中评估患者的自我矫正能力，可能有助于预测治疗效果。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗性脊柱侧凸特异性运动中主动自我矫正的影像学量化及其在青少年特发性脊柱侧凸中的潜在预后价值
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性研究（n=未注明）发现，物理治疗性脊柱侧凸特异性运动（PSSE）中的主动自我矫正可使Cobb角矫正27.32%（从37.57°至28.82°），且是唯一与6个月治疗后Cobb角变化显著相关的变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective study for the first time radiographically quantified active self-correction (ASC) during PSSE in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis and found it correlated with Cobb angle change at 6 months. This suggests that assessing patients' self-correction ability in practice may help predict treatment outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究的样本量相对较小，且随访期为6个月，尚不能完全评估长期预后价值。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small, and the 6-month follow-up period is insufficient to fully assess long-term prognostic value.

items.title: Interactive Gardening Intervention for Preschoolers With Developmental Delays: A Family-Centered Feasibility Study.
items.summary: An interactive, family-centered gardening intervention improved social functioning in preschool children with developmental delays (mean change, 3.34 ± 9.47; p = .007) compared to controls, with caregivers reporting high satisfaction, according to a pilot study (n=60 dyads).
items.curatedReason: 对于发育迟缓儿童，家庭园艺干预或许能改善他们的社交功能。尽管只是一个小规模观察研究（60个家庭），且效果幅度偏小（平均改善3.34），但对这类患者的社交支持而言，是一个有意思且值得探索的非传统补充方式。
items.titleZh: 发育迟缓学龄前儿童互动园艺干预：一项以家庭为中心的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项试点研究（60对亲子）显示，与对照组相比，互动式家庭园艺干预改善了发育迟缓学龄前儿童的社交功能（平均变化3.34 ± 9.47；p = .007），家长满意度高。
items.curatedReasonEn: For children with developmental delays, family-centered gardening might improve social functioning. While a small observational study (60 dyads) with a modest effect (mean change 3.34), it's a noteworthy, non-traditional complementary approach worth exploring for social support in this population.
items.limitation: 这是一项非随机对照的试点研究，样本量小，且部分结果未达到统计学意义。
items.limitationEn: This was a non-randomized controlled pilot study with a small sample size, and some results did not reach statistical significance.

items.title: The effect of multi-joint lower-limb training on lower-limb function after total knee arthroplasty: a randomised controlled clinical trial
items.summary: Integrating hip-ankle training into conventional rehabilitation after TKA modestly improved early postoperative LEFS at 4 weeks (+1.55 points, 95% CI 0.02 to 3.07, P = 0.047) in 128 patients, but this advantage diminished by week 12.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，在全膝关节置换术后常规康复中加入髋踝关节训练，在早期（术后4周）对LEFS评分有小幅改善，但临床意义不明显，且优势不持久。在改变常规实践前，需要更强的证据和更长的随访。
items.titleZh: 多关节下肢训练对全膝关节置换术后下肢功能的影响：一项随机对照临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对128名全膝关节置换术后患者的随机对照试验发现，在常规康复中加入髋踝关节训练，可在术后4周适度改善下肢功能量表（LEFS）评分（+1.55分，95% CI 0.02-3.07，P = 0.047），但此优势在12周时减弱。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that adding hip-ankle training to conventional rehabilitation after TKA modestly improves early postoperative LEFS scores at 4 weeks, but the clinical significance is limited and the benefit is not sustained. Stronger evidence and longer follow-up are needed before altering routine practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心研究，随访时间相对较短（12周），且主要结局的临床重要性阈值未明确达到。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center study with a relatively short follow-up (12 weeks), and the clinical importance threshold for the primary outcome was not clearly met.

items.title: GLIM-defined malnutrition and frailty in older outpatients with diabetes
items.summary: Among 391 older outpatients with diabetes, GLIM-defined malnutrition was prevalent in 33% and independently associated with frailty (OR 2.405, 95% CI 1.275–4.537, p = 0.007), according to a retrospective study.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究揭示，在患有糖尿病的老年门诊患者中，GLIM标准定义的营养不良非常普遍（33%），且与衰弱独立相关。这提示你在对老年糖尿病患者进行综合老年评估时，应高度关注营养不良和衰弱的筛查与管理，以支持更个体化的临床干预。
items.titleZh: GLIM定义的营养不良与糖尿病老年门诊患者的衰弱
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究显示，在391名糖尿病老年门诊患者中，33%存在GLIM定义的营养不良，且营养不良与衰弱独立相关（OR 2.405, 95% CI 1.275–4.537, p = 0.007）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study reveals that GLIM-defined malnutrition is highly prevalent (33%) and independently associated with frailty in older outpatients with diabetes. This suggests that when conducting comprehensive geriatric assessments for older diabetic patients, you should prioritize screening and managing malnutrition and frailty to support more individualized clinical interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果可能受到未测量混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study, which cannot establish causality, and results may be influenced by unmeasured confounding factors.

items.title: Physical and psychosocial outcomes in children with limb loss 2-years after the 2023 Kahramanmaras-Türkiye earthquakes
items.summary: A retrospective analysis (n=56) of children with earthquake-related limb loss 2.3 years post-amputation showed favorable physical, social, and school-related quality of life (median PedsQL 72.3/100.0), but lower emotional functioning (60.0/100.0). Unilateral lower limb loss was associated with superior adjustment and prosthetic satisfaction.
items.curatedReason: 大地震两年后，儿童截肢者的肢体功能、社会功能和学校相关生活质量表现良好，但情感健康仍受影响，提示康复服务应整合长期心理健康支持。
items.titleZh: 2023 年卡赫拉曼马拉什-土耳其地震两年后肢体缺失儿童的身体和心理社会结局
items.summaryZh: 一项对 56 名地震相关肢体缺失儿童的回顾性分析显示，截肢 2.3 年后，其身体、社会和学校相关生活质量良好（PedsQL 中位数 72.3/100.0），但情感功能较低（60.0/100.0）。单侧下肢缺失的儿童表现出更好的适应性和假肢满意度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Two years post-earthquake, children with limb loss showed favorable physical, social, and school-related quality of life, but emotional well-being remained affected. This highlights the need for integrated long-term mental health support within rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性分析，样本来自单一康复中心，可能存在选择偏倚和数据完整性限制。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective analysis with samples from a single rehabilitation center, which may introduce selection bias and data completeness limitations.

items.title: Power of Functional Mobility Tests in Predicting Fall Risk Among Older Adults.
items.summary: A prospective observational study found that the Timed Up and Go Test (TUG, AUC=0.777) and Four Square Step Test (FSST, AUC=0.771) had the highest discrimination for predicting falls in older adults, though no single test was sufficiently strong alone. Combining tests with fall history (AUC 0.89-0.97) improved model fit.
items.curatedReason: TUG 和 FSST 在预测老年人跌倒风险方面表现出最高的区分度，但单一测试的效能不足以独立预测。将功能测试与跌倒史结合使用可提高预测准确性。
items.titleZh: 功能性活动能力测试在预测老年人跌倒风险中的效用
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察性研究发现，计时起立行走测试（TUG，AUC=0.777）和四方步进测试（FSST，AUC=0.771）在预测老年人跌倒方面具有最高的区分度，但单一测试不足以可靠预测。将功能测试与跌倒史结合（AUC 0.89-0.97）可提高模型拟合度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The TUG and FSST showed the highest discrimination for fall risk in older adults, but individual tests were insufficient for standalone prediction. Combining functional tests with fall history improved predictive accuracy.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性队列研究，样本量相对较小，且功能测试与跌倒史结合的发现需外部验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational cohort study with a relatively small sample size, and the findings regarding combining functional tests with fall history require external validation.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effectiveness of a Structured Post-Platelet Rich Plasma Rehabilitation Approach on Pain and Function in Subacromial Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A 21-day structured post-PRP rehabilitation approach, added to standard physiotherapy, significantly improved pain (VAS: 9.00 ± 0.67 to 2.92 ± 1.14 vs. 9.11 ± 0.64 to 7.96 ± 0.75, p < 0.001) and function in 27 subacromial pain syndrome participants compared to standard physiotherapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 结构化康复方案与 PRP 联合使用对肩峰下疼痛综合征有短期益处，尤其是在疼痛缓解、肌力、活动度和功能方面。将其视为标准疗法之外的潜在补充，但要注意尚无长期随访数据。
items.titleZh: 结构化 PRP 术后康复方案对肩峰下疼痛综合征疼痛与功能的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 21 天的随机对照试验显示，在标准物理治疗基础上增加结构化 PRP 术后康复方案，在肩峰下疼痛综合征患者中显著改善疼痛（VAS 从 9.00 ± 0.67 降至 2.92 ± 1.14，对照组从 9.11 ± 0.64 降至 7.96 ± 0.75；p < 0.001）和功能，共 27 名受试者参与。
items.curatedReasonEn: A structured rehabilitation approach combined with PRP shows short-term benefits for subacromial pain syndrome, particularly in pain relief, muscle strength, range of motion, and function. Consider it a potential adjunct to standard therapy, but note the lack of long-term follow-up data.
items.limitation: 本研究的随访期仅为 21 天，无法评估长期效果和改善的可持续性。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was only 21 days, preventing assessment of long-term effects and sustainability of improvements.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Treatment Planning in Physical and Rehabilitation Medicine: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review found 9 studies showing Large Language Models (LLMs) have promising capabilities in supporting rehabilitation treatment planning, with concordance rates up to 98.75% with expert opinion, though "hallucinations" were reported.
items.curatedReason: 大型语言模型（LLM）在康复治疗计划中展现出前景，能与专家意见保持高度一致，尤其在肌骨和心血管康复领域。你可以关注其在辅助个性化方案制定上的潜力，但需警惕“幻觉”现象，人工监督仍不可或缺。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在物理和康复医学治疗计划中的作用：一项系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述纳入 9 项研究发现，大型语言模型（LLMs）在康复治疗计划中展现出前景，与专家意见的一致性可达 98.75%，但需注意其潜在的“幻觉”问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in rehabilitation treatment planning, aligning well with expert opinions, especially in musculoskeletal and cardiovascular rehab. Monitor their potential for assisting personalized plan development, but be aware of "hallucinations"; human supervision remains essential.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量有限，且 LLM 存在“幻觉”问题，仍需高质量研究验证其在实际康复中的有效性和安全性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies and the issue of LLM "hallucinations" mean that high-quality research is still needed to validate their real-world effectiveness and safety in rehabilitation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: From Referral to Reality: A Mixed Methods Analysis of Barriers to Pediatric Rehabilitation Service Initiation.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study of 8,533 pediatric rehabilitation referrals found only a 42.7% service initiation rate, with barriers including geographic availability, scheduling, communication, and financial challenges, varying by patient characteristics.
items.curatedReason: 这项混合方法研究揭示了儿童康复服务依从性低（仅 42.7%）背后的复杂障碍，包括地理可及性、排班困难、费用、交通以及专业人员与家庭沟通不畅等。应关注这些因素，以提高服务启动率并减少社会人口学差异。
items.titleZh: 从转诊到现实：儿科康复服务启动障碍的混合方法分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8,533 份儿科康复转诊的混合方法研究显示，服务启动率仅为 42.7%，障碍包括地域可及性、排班、沟通和财务挑战，并因患者特征而异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This mixed-methods study reveals complex barriers behind low pediatric rehabilitation service initiation rates (only 42.7%), including geographic availability, scheduling difficulties, cost, transportation, and poor communication between professionals and families. Addressing these factors is crucial for improving service initiation and reducing sociodemographic disparities.
items.limitation: 这项研究来自单一的儿科医疗机构，其结果可能存在地域性和系统性局限，不一定能完全推广至其他医疗系统或更广泛的地理区域。
items.limitationEn: This study was conducted within a single pediatric healthcare organization, and its findings may have geographic and systemic limitations, potentially not fully generalizable to other healthcare systems or broader regions.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
